dedupe_keys.name: dataifn french national forest inventory raw field data ign

description: DataIFN is the IGN tool for viewing and downloading the field data collected by the French national forest inventory. Users tick the information they want, see the matching inventory points on a map and download the corresponding data files; the page also offers direct downloads of the documentation of the raw data, of all raw data since 2005, and of the latest campaign, with raw data last updated on 14 October 2025. The field measurement and observation manual (IMOT) is available in French. The data and documentation are free to download and reuse without fees under the Etalab Open Licence version 2.0, and users must cite the source in the wording given on the page. Caveats: the page states that the raw data passed many checks but carries no warranty from IGN, and the documentation is mainly in French. Coverage is France, as annual campaigns since 2005. It supports green infrastructure and forest condition analysis, for example storm, drought and fire exposure of forests near power lines and roads, and climate adaptation; related records are the German Bundeswaldinventur and the National Forest Inventory of Great Britain.
